pages.quiz:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Sehr gut" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. very good
   B. see you soon
   C. yes
   D. please

2. Which goodbye is friendly and used between friends? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Abend
   B. Tschüss
   C. Guten Tag
   D. Gute Nacht

3. What does "der Sohn" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. uncle
   B. friend
   C. brother
   D. son

4. Which noun goes with "mein"? (1 mark)
   A. Mutter
   B. Schwester
   C. Vater
   D. Tante

5. What does "im" stand for? (1 mark)
   A. in der
   B. in die
   C. in dem
   D. an dem

6. Which of these is a piece of furniture? (1 mark)
   A. das Haus
   B. der Stuhl
   C. der Garten
   D. die Küche

7. Why do we copy the teacher's sounds when learning German? (1 mark)
   A. To learn only spelling
   B. To avoid reading
   C. To learn the sounds accurately by practice
   D. To make the class noisy

8. What does "das Haus" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. house
   B. door
   C. clock
   D. room

9. What does "heute" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. often
   B. always
   C. today
   D. now

10. Which day comes right after Dienstag? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag
   B. Mittwoch
   C. Freitag
   D. Montag

11. What number is "sechzehn"? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 10
   C. 20
   D. 14

12. What number is "drei"? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 12
   C. 0
   D. 3

13. What does "der Saft" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. banana
   B. juice
   C. apple
   D. cabbage or kale

14. What does "das Abendessen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. supper
   B. water
   C. onion
   D. watermelon

15. What does "das Ohr" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. ear
   B. mouth
   C. finger
   D. tummy

16. What does "der Rücken" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. finger
   B. ear
   C. back
   D. toe

17. What does "der Himmel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sky
   B. rainbow
   C. snow
   D. weather

18. How is the word "heiß" pronounced? (1 mark)
   A. like hate
   B. like hoyss
   C. like hiss
   D. like hice

19. Which safety idea is right for the kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Let children play with matches
   B. Keep hot pots and matches away from small children
   C. Leave the cooker on when you go out
   D. Block the door

20. What does "kochen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to cook
   B. to smell
   C. to sleep
   D. to dance

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. You hear "Auf dem Mount Kenya ist es kalt. Dort schneit es manchmal." What is the gist? (2 marks)

22. Explain the difference in sound between "ie" and "ei" and give one example day for each. (3 marks)

23. Say what the tongue twister "Montags macht mir meine muntere Mutter mittags meistens Mus" means in English. (2 marks)

24. Write in German: "I have two ears." (2 marks)

25. Write the German words with their articles for: kitchen, bedroom, garden, living room. (4 marks)

26. Say why we practise tongue twisters when learning to pronounce German. (2 marks)

27. Write a short German dialogue of three lines in which two children greet each other, ask their names and answer. (3 marks)

28. Say why the word "Schlafzimmer" is a das word. (2 marks)

29. Give two reasons why imitating a teacher or a recording helps when learning German sounds. (2 marks)

30. Write in German: "Who is that? That is my mother." (2 marks)

31. Write two sentences in German: one about a food you like to eat and one about a drink you like to drink. (3 marks)

32. Give three German words or phrases for saying goodbye and say which is friendly and which is polite. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — very good
   Sehr gut means very good.

2. B — Tschüss
   Tschüss is the relaxed way of saying bye.

3. D — son
   der Sohn means son.

4. C — Vater
   Vater is a der word, so we say mein Vater.

5. C — in dem
   im is the short form of in dem.

6. B — der Stuhl
   A chair (der Stuhl) is furniture. The others are places.

7. C — To learn the sounds accurately by practice
   Imitation trains the ears and mouth to make the new sounds.

8. A — house
   das Haus means house.

9. C — today
   heute means today.

10. B — Mittwoch
   After Dienstag comes Mittwoch.

11. A — 16
   sechzehn is the number 16.

12. D — 3
   drei is the number 3.

13. B — juice
   der Saft means juice.

14. A — supper
   das Abendessen means supper.

15. A — ear
   das Ohr means ear.

16. C — back
   der Rücken means back.

17. A — sky
   der Himmel means sky.

18. D — like hice
   ei sounds like eye and ß is a strong s.

19. B — Keep hot pots and matches away from small children
   Small children must be kept away from heat and matches.

20. A — to cook
   kochen means to cook.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is cold on Mount Kenya and sometimes it snows there.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for cold, 1 mark for snow.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: ie sounds like ee (Dienstag); ei sounds like eye (Freitag).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sound and 1 mark for correct examples.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: On Mondays my lively mother usually makes me mush at midday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Mondays and mother, 1 mark for the mush at midday.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ich habe zwei Ohren.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Ich habe zwei and 1 mark for Ohren.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Küche, das Schlafzimmer, der Garten, das Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: They repeat similar sounds, so the tongue and lips learn to move clearly and smoothly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for repeated sounds and 1 mark for clear speech.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: A: Hallo! Wie heißt du? B: Ich heiße Otieno. A: Ich heiße Amina.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for the question Wie heißt du?, 1 mark for the answer with Ich heiße.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Its last part, Zimmer, is a das word, and a joined word takes the article of the last part.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for last part, 1 mark for Zimmer being das.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: We hear the right sounds and practise them again and again, so our mouth learns them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wer ist das? Das ist meine Mutter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich esse gern Mais. Ich trinke gern Tee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tschüss (friendly), Auf Wiedersehen (polite), Bis morgen (see you tomorrow).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct phrase; award the marks only if the friendly and polite ones are identified sensibly.
